role: Visual feature extractors for Layer 2 object identity matching via color binning and ONNX embeddings.
detail: Three complementary extractor classes: DominantColorExtractor (pure-Python 8x8x8 RGB histogram binning, no deps), MockEmbeddingExtractor (fixed test vectors with per-bbox overrides), OnnxEmbeddingExtractor (EfficientNet-B0 via ONNX Runtime, lazy-imports cv2/onnxruntime). All extract from raw RGB byte arrays given (frame_data, bbox, frame_width, frame_height) and return either list[tuple[int,int,int]] (dominant colors) or list[float] (embeddings). EmbeddingExtractor is a @runtime_checkable Protocol. DominantColorExtractor bins each pixel into 512 bins (8^3), counts occurrences, and returns top-N bin centers sorted by frequency. OnnxEmbeddingExtractor resizes crops to 224x224, applies ImageNet norm (mean=[0.485,0.456,0.406], std=[0.229,0.224,0.225]), runs ONNX inference, and returns 1280-dim feature vector. Auto-downloads efficientnet_b0.onnx from GitHub on first use. No side effects beyond model download (filesystem write only on missing model).
gotchas: OnnxEmbeddingExtractor imports cv2 and onnxruntime in __init__ (deferred, not module-level) to allow graceful fallback in tests; model auto-download is stdlib urllib.request only (no requests dep); DominantColorExtractor clamping ensures edge bboxes handled safely; degenerate (zero-area) bboxes return empty list for DominantColorExtractor and None for OnnxEmbeddingExtractor; all coordinate inputs are float (clamped to int pixel coords internally).
